§6Solar Steam Setup§f

§aNow you need something to turn all that steam into actual power.§f

The §bSteam Engine§f converts steam into HE. Hook it up to your Solar Tower Boiler with a steam pipe, provide fresh water as coolant, and connect power cables to extract the electricity.

It outputs exhaust steam as a byproduct. Don't waste it: a §bSteam Condenser§f turns exhaust back into water, creating a closed-loop system that keeps everything running smoothly.

Crafted at the §bAssembly Machine§f using welded plates and advanced components.

§ePS:§f The engine can also run on regular boilers, not just solar. Any steam source works.
